name: core-move-asteroid
description: Rules audit (core): LRR 12 ASTEROID FIELD - ships cannot move into an asteroid field without Antimass Deflectors. The original only posted a 'friendly reminder'; now Done moving / the direct move into one is refused (MovementRules.destinationRefusal: bot finishMovement, tactical.move validate, TacticalController) and the web move bar says why with Move greyed. Base: pbd104@59; muaat (no Antimass Deflectors) gets a cruiser at 102 and activates the asteroid field at 101 (activating is legal): moving the cruiser in is refused and the movement prompt stays.
